استقصيتم (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَيْتُمْ (istaqṣaytum) /is.taq.sˤaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
# اُسْتُقْصِيتُمْ (ustuqṣītum) /us.tuq.sˤiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْصَى (istaqṣā)
